[operator-attested] Close disposition — investigation bug remediated by epic 10ae.

1e88 is an investigation/observability bug. Its investigation deliverables (ACs 1, 3, 4) are complete and captured in the description:
- AC1 (root cause as changeable artifact): agentic-runner request-count + unbounded per-request context accumulation (llm/plan_review/passes.py, llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py), grounded in per-request telemetry — not provider raw latency (A/B refutes that).
- AC3 (provider A/B preserved): single-shot within-noise across Anthropic and Bedrock; agentic passes minutes-scale on BOTH — retained verbatim in the description.
- AC4 (remediation cross-referenced): the shared agentic-runner remediation was delivered by epic 10ae (MERGED on origin/main) — lever-1 criteria-scaled floor (llm/completion.py:92 verify_step_floor), lever-2 banking (llm/workflow/completion_banking.py), lever-3 prefetch (llm/workflow/completion_prefetch.py); 26 covering tests pass.

AC2 (repeatable per-pass sidecar measurement) is explicitly OWNED by task 4a40-ea6e-d3f7-4af7 (reinstate coverage.metrics on the workflow gate), which remains in_progress. That measurement axis is deliberately tracked separately (the description scopes it to 4a40), so AC2 is deferred there rather than done here — tagged [tracked:4a40]. Closing 1e88 as its investigation is complete and its remediation landed; the before/after telemetry assertion continues under 4a40. Force-close used because AC2's evidence inherently lands under 4a40, not this ticket.
